name: Remi
description: Shared ledger for the Remi agent pipeline: durable audit trail, context reconstruction, and prior-findings recall across fresh sessions.

connectionString.description: Postgres connection string for the ledger. Falls back to REMI_LEDGER_URL.

poolMax.description: Max Postgres pool connections. Pipeline peak width is 2, so 4 is ample.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the project under review. When set, ledger_write rejects any cited location whose path does not exist, so a fabricated file citation cannot enter the ledger. Falls back to REMI_PROJECT_ROOT.
